questions.q: Why were the expected numbers for the evaluation computed with a separate plain-pandas code path?
options: Because run_data cannot compute sums
To make the evaluation run faster
Because the stub requires it
So the ground truth is independent of the tool's own code and can catch its mistakes
questions.explain: If you check a tool against its own logic, a shared bug passes silently. An independent calculation gives a fair reference.

questions.q: What does a 7/7 pass rate with the stubbed model actually prove?
options: That the assistant is intelligent
That the plumbing (routing, validation, pandas, retrieval, refusal) is wired together correctly for these questions
That a real model will also score 7/7
That the tool needs no more testing
questions.explain: The stub was written with these questions in mind, so the score verifies the pipeline, not the model. A real model needs a new evaluation.

questions.q: "Which region had the most revenue?" returned total revenue across everything. Why is this worse than the "send an item back" miss?
options: It is a confident, plausible wrong answer, while the other was a safe refusal
It was slower
It used more tokens
It exposed private data
questions.explain: A refusal is visible and harmless. A silent wrong answer looks correct and can mislead decisions, so it deserves priority when fixing.

questions.q: What must you do after swapping the stub for a real model client?
options: Nothing, since the function signature is the same
Delete the retrieval code
Rewrite the prompts in natural language and re-run the full evaluation, expecting new failure modes
Remove the validation step
questions.explain: The prefixes used by the stub are not real instructions, and a real model fails in different ways, so the test set must be re-run.

questions.q: Which statement belongs in the project README's real-versus-stubbed section?
options: Everything in this tool is powered by a real hosted model
The language model was a rule-based stub; retrieval, validation, and pandas calculations were real
The pandas calculations were written by the model
Nothing in this project was tested
questions.explain: Stating plainly what was stubbed builds trust and shows you understand the difference between the plumbing and the model.
